card.name: Words just before body fat
card.fires_on: Words that come right before 'fat' or 'obesity' in talk of body fat, such as 'burn off', 'get rid of' and 'central'. It appears in fat-loss advice and in fat redistribution warnings.

modes.label: Fat-loss advice
modes.description: Verbs and small words leading up to 'fat' when talking about losing body fat or getting abs.
modes.example: It's not possible to<< burn>> off fat from one area of your body

modes.label: Fat redistribution label text
modes.description: The word 'central' in the list of body fat changes seen with HIV drugs.
modes.example: Redistribution/accumulation of body fat, including<< central>> obesity

card.writes: It makes the word 'fat' (and related words like obesity) more likely to come next, including in Chinese.
